description: Render a 3D mesh file (STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY) to a PNG image. Headless, no GUI. Returns the PNG path/URL and the mesh bounding-box dimensions in model units.
name: render_mesh

mesh_path.description: Absolute path or filename of the mesh (e.g. part.stl) produced by the CAD sandbox

prompt.description: Short description of the part, used only by the review loop

review.description: If true AND CAD_RENDER_REVIEW_LOOP=1, send the PNG to the vision model for a geometry critique

description: Render OpenSCAD source code to a PNG using the openscad binary in headless --render mode.
name: render_openscad

description: Convert between CAD/mesh formats (STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY; STEP read is best-effort if build123d/OCP is present). Returns the output path/URL.
name: convert_cad

input_path.description: Absolute path or filename of the input model

to_format.description: Target extension without dot: stl | 3mf | obj | ply

description: PRIMARY tool for parts with holes/pockets/patterns/shells/standoffs. Generate a parametric part from a constrained feature-level JSON geometry description (base solid + named features positioned by face+anchor+offset, never raw 3D coordinates). Validates, emits OpenSCAD, compiles, mesh-validates, renders, and self-corrects (auto-retries deterministic fixes) in one call. Returns scad_source, stl_path, png_url, validation (watertight/volume/bbox/problems), attempts, retry_log.
name: generate_scad

geometry.description: Feature-level part description for generate_scad. Z-up, right-handed, millimetres: width=X, depth=Y, height=Z; a flat plate's thickness is height, never depth. Tier A (base + named features positioned by face+anchor+offset) is preferred — the model describes WHAT and deterministic code computes WHERE.

units.description: All dimensions are millimetres. Coordinates are right-handed and Z-up.

parameters.description: Named variables: name -> number or arithmetic expression string referencing other parameters (e.g. "width - 2*wall_thickness"). Resolved by a restricted evaluator, never eval().

base.description: Tier A primary solid. Z-up/right-handed: box width=X, depth=Y, height=Z. For a flat plate, thickness is height. Types: box, cylinder, prism (regular N-sided prism: hexagon/octagon bars, nuts, standoffs), revolve (stepped/flanged/revolved body from a radius-height profile: bushings, pulleys, spacers), angle (L-bracket: two legs at 90 degrees with optional inner fillet).

dimensions.description: box: width=X, depth=Y, height=Z; cylinder: radius in XY, axis at (radius,radius), and height=Z; prism: sides (3-32) + exactly one of across_flats or circumradius + height, axis along Z, one vertex on +X, bounding box starts at the origin; revolve: profile = list of [radius, z] points describing the closed cross-section revolved about the Z axis (include the bore: its radius is the smallest r), axis at the bounding-box centre, z starts at 0; angle: L-bracket with width=X (length of both legs), depth=Y (horizontal leg, outer), height=Z (vertical leg, outer, measured from the bottom of the horizontal leg), thickness (both legs), inner_radius (optional fillet in the inside corner); the vertical leg stands at y=0..thickness. Millimetres. For a flat plate thickness is height.

depth.description: Y-axis extent in millimetres; not plate thickness.

height.description: Z-axis extent in millimetres; this is plate thickness.

radius.description: Cylinder radius in the XY plane, in millimetres.

sides.description: prism: number of sides of the regular polygon.

across_flats.description: prism: distance between two opposite flats, in millimetres (use this for hex stock / nuts / standoffs).

circumradius.description: prism: distance from the axis to a vertex, in millimetres (alternative to across_flats).

profile.description: revolve: closed cross-section as [radius, z] points in order around the outline (radius >= 0, never crossing the axis). Example flanged bushing: [[5,0],[15,0],[15,3],[8,3],[8,20],[5,20]].

thickness.description: angle: thickness of both legs, in millimetres.

inner_radius.description: angle: radius of the fillet in the inside corner (0 or omitted for a sharp corner).

holes.description: Cylindrical through/blind holes positioned by face + semantic anchor + offset, never by raw 3D coordinates.

depth.description: Omit or set >= base thickness for a through-hole.

chamfer.description: Symmetric edge chamfer size in mm at the hole entrance.

pockets.description: Rectangular recesses positioned by face + anchor + offset.

depth_dim.description: Pocket footprint depth (in-plane), not cut depth.

cut_depth.description: How far the pocket is cut into the base.

standoffs.description: Cylindrical bosses (e.g. for M3 self-tapping screws), positioned by face + anchor + offset.

inner_diameter.description: Pilot hole diameter, omit for solid boss.

fillets.description: Edge rounding on the base solid's vertical edges (2D-profile round via minkowski, per emitter implementation).

chamfers.description: Edge chamfers on the base solid.

ribs.description: Thin reinforcement webs between two faces.

pattern.description: Repeat a named feature (by index into its list) linearly or circularly.

feature_index.description: Index of the template feature within its list to repeat.

angle.description: circular pattern: total sweep angle in degrees (default 360).

escape_hatch.description: Tier B: bounded CSG subtree for geometry the Tier-A vocabulary can't express. Steer to Tier A first; only drop here when necessary. Parameter references and expressions are still resolved by the emitter.

csgNode.description: One node in a constrained CSG tree: a primitive, a transform wrapping one child, or a boolean/extrude op over children.

max_retries.description: Max auto-repair attempts inside the tool before returning to the model

description: Build a part as an exact build123d BREP solid from a feature-level JSON description, in one call that validates, builds, measures and exports STEP + STL + PNG. Base types: box (plate/block), cylinder (disc/tube), prism (regular N-sided bar: hex stock, nut, hex standoff — give across_flats or circumradius), revolve (stepped/flanged/revolved body from a [radius, z] profile — bushing, spacer, pulley, include the bore in the profile), angle (L-bracket: width, depth, height, thickness, inner_radius). Features positioned by face + anchor + offset, never raw 3D coordinates: holes (incl. chamfer/counterbore/countersink), and on box/cylinder bases also pockets, ribs, standoffs on OUTER faces, an open-top shell, patterns and outer-edge fillets/chamfers. prism/revolve/angle bases take holes only (prism and revolve on top/bottom; angle on bottom = horizontal leg, front = vertical leg). NOT for gears, lofts, multi-body assemblies, or features inside a shelled box — use cad_build. Returns script, measure, validate, printability, step_url, stl_url, png_url, script_url, stl_path; on a design error it returns error/error_category/error_detail (fix and call again); error_category 'kernel_gap' means use cad_build.

name: cad_build
description: PRIMARY CAD PATH. Build a part from a complete build123d Python script in a fresh session (reset, execute, measure, validate in one call). Units mm, Z-up. Start with `from build123d import *`; end with show(part, 'part'). Returns ok, measure (volume/bbox/topology), validate (validity gate). On failure returns error, last_error (line + excerpt) and repair_hints: fix the script and call cad_build again. When ok, call cad_finalize.

name: cad_execute
description: Run additional build123d code in the CURRENT session (incremental edit after cad_build; previous variables remain defined). Returns ok or error + last_error + repair_hints.

name: cad_measure
description: Measure the current (or named) shape: volume mm^3, area, bbox per-axis sizes, face/edge counts. Use to verify dimensions against the request.

name: cad_find_holes
description: Recognise drilled holes on the current (or named) shape: count, axis, location, diameter, depth, through/blind, counterbore. Use to verify hole count, size and placement.

name: cad_render
description: Render the current (or named) shape to a PNG and return its URL. direction: iso, top, front, right, left, back, bottom.

name: cad_finalize
description: Deliver the part: validity gate, export STEP + STL, FDM printability analysis, iso render and the full build123d script. Returns step_url, stl_url, script_url, png_url, measure and printability findings. Call once the part is correct.

basename.description: Short file name for the part, e.g. sensor_enclosure.
